description_en: Calls DeleteComment to delete a comment message
kebab_example: aliyun imp delete-comment --app-id 7m000q --room-id AE350000T95F --user-id as0000hs --comment-id-list 09000f8 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteComment

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application. This ID is generated when you create the application in the console. The value contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the room, returned when you call CreateRoom
parameters.help_zh: 房间的唯一标识，在调用CreateRoom时返回
parameters.name: room_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the operator, which indicates who performed the delete comment message operation
parameters.help_zh: 操作人的用户ID，用于表示谁执行了删除弹幕消息的操作
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The list of comment message IDs to delete. The maximum length of the list cannot exceed 100
parameters.help_zh: 需要删除的弹幕消息ID的列表。列表的最大长度不得超过100
parameters.name: comment_id_list

Result.description_en: The result of deleting the room comment message
Result.description_zh: 调用删除房间弹幕消息的返回结果

DeleteResult.description_en:
The deletion result. Valid values:
true: Deleted.
false: Failed to delete
DeleteResult.description_zh: 删除的结果。其中true表示删除成功，false表示删除失败

Result.title_en: 调用删除直播间弹幕的返回结果。
Result.title_zh: 调用删除直播间弹幕的返回结果。
